title: Taught teams to prioritize technical debt with data
summary: I taught a two-hour hands-on Philips University workshop on finding and prioritizing technical debt with code-health analysis; its announcement reached 4,131 people and the program scored an NPS of 83.
what_would_have_happened: Teams would treat technical debt as one long backlog, with no clear way to pick the high-impact, low-effort fixes.
the_call: Show teams the hotspots in a codebase and start with high-impact, low-effort fixes.
what_i_did: Ran the hands-on workshop and announced a second session when demand continued.
what_changed: The announcement reached 4,131 people and the program scored an NPS of 83.
